question: Which football club in India has the longest history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarada FC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sarada FC**, founded in 1879, is the oldest football club in India and among the oldest in Asia.
 
• The club was established in Calcutta (now Kolkata), which was the hub of football during British colonial rule in India.
 
• Sarada FC is considered a pioneer in introducing organized football in India and has a significant historical legacy.
 
• Although the club is not active in modern professional football, its contribution to the foundation of Indian football remains notable.
 
• The early emergence of clubs like Sarada FC helped popularize football as a sport in India, particularly in Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Football in India:**

 
 
• Football was introduced in India by British soldiers and gained popularity in the late 19th century.
 
• Calcutta became the epicenter of Indian football, with several clubs emerging during British rule.
 
• The Durand Cup, established in 1888, is one of the oldest football tournaments globally and is still held annually in India.
 
 
 
• **East Bengal Club:**
 
 
• Founded in 1920, East Bengal Club is one of India’s most famous football clubs, with a rich legacy in both domestic and international tournaments.
 
• It is part of the historic Kolkata football rivalry with Mohun Bagan, known as the "Boro Match" or "Kolkata Derby."
 
 
 
• **Mohun Bagan Athletic Club:**
 
 
• Founded in 1889, Mohun Bagan is another iconic football club in India, known for its historic victory against the East Yorkshire Regiment in 1911.
 
• That victory marked the first time an Indian team defeated a British team, symbolizing national pride.
 
 
 
• **Indian Super League (ISL):**
 
 
• Launched in 2014, the ISL is a professional football league in India aimed at increasing the popularity of football nationwide.
 
• Clubs like Mumbai City FC and ATK Mohun Bagan are prominent participants in the league.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Football in Bengal:**
 
 
• Bengal has been the heart of Indian football for over a century, producing many legendary players and hosting iconic matches.
 
• The passion for football in Bengal remains strong, with clubs like East Bengal and Mohun Bagan enjoying massive fan followings.
